title: get-class-arg-wrong-class (clean-room semantics)

ground_truth.statement: The Left switch branch cannot call a method that exists only on Right; the Left input throws Error.

allowed.reason: The required nonexistent method has no return signature; this is a secondary consequence, not an additional type error on a sound return.

notes: The local source is a lead, not an oracle. Fixture and deterministic controls are re-derived from PHP semantics.
